title: Find female patients who have had at least two laboratory tests showing abn
question: Find female patients who have had at least two laboratory tests showing abnormal white blood cell counts and also have at least one examination with a positive coagulation result (RVVT = '+'). For each such patient, report whether their uric acid level was within the normal female range in any of those abnormal WBC tests.

prediction.sql: SELECT P.XCL_058, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058 AND (L.XCL_030 < 3.5 OR L.XCL_030 > 9.0) AND L.XCL_022 <= 6.5) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS uric_acid_normal FROM Patient AS P WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'F' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory AS L WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058 AND (L.XCL_030 < 3.5 OR L.XCL_030 > 9.0)) >= 2 AND P.XCL_058 IN (SELECT E.XCL_001 FROM Examination AS E WHERE E.XCL_011 = '+')

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    P.XCL_058,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory L
        WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058
          AND (L.XCL_030 < 3.5 OR L.XCL_030 > 9.0)
          AND L.XCL_022 BETWEEN 2.4 AND 6.5
      ) THEN 'Yes'
      ELSE 'No'
    END AS uric_acid_normal
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'F'
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058
      AND (L.XCL_030 < 3.5 OR L.XCL_030 > 9.0)
  ) >= 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination E
    WHERE E.XCL_001 = P.XCL_058
      AND E.XCL_011 = '+'
  );

SELECT
    P.XCL_058,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory L
        WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058
          AND (L.XCL_030 < 3.5 OR L.XCL_030 > 9.0)
          AND L.XCL_022 <= 6.5
      ) THEN 'Yes'
      ELSE 'No'
    END AS uric_acid_normal
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'F'
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058
      AND (L.XCL_030 < 3.5 OR L.XCL_030 > 9.0)
  ) >= 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination E
    WHERE E.XCL_001 = P.XCL_058
      AND E.XCL_011 = '+'
  );

    P.XCL_058,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (

  );
